context:
Goal: the ruled-store change (PR #2992, one home for the rulings store) merges tonight.
Problem (rule): after its fix check passed, the batch run found a 6-line test-only defect, and the merge tool records only one fix check per record, so recording the fix needs your grant for a fourth round.
Based on (read): decision pr-review-record on main says "One fix verifier per record"; a second fix gets a fresh full review.
Based on (ruling): your Nov 8 pick a (10:19 CST) let a review chain hold two fix checks; the decision kept only one, and step fix-after-fix-check files that gap.
Departs from: main's three-round review cap — adds a fourth round for PR #2992 only.
Why yours: a round past the cap needs your grant (rule roles-review-cap-three).

options.gain: The ruled-store change merges tonight with the small test fix recorded, and the batch moves on.
options.how: Triage writes the grant line `Grant: #2992, item 675 a, owner, 2026-11-12 <time you save> CST`; the lane records the fix as round 4.
options.label: Grant round 4 (recommended)
options.lose: One more review round on a 6-line test fix.

options.gain: The three-round cap holds with no exception.
options.how: The lane starts a fresh full review chain on its new head.
options.label: No grant: fresh full review
options.lose: The change waits for up to three new rounds; others queued behind it wait too.

reply: Closed 22:06 CST Nov 12 by triage: you picked a in chat ("2992 can review again"). Grant: #2992, item 675 a, owner, 2026-11-12 22:06 CST. Sent to the coordinator and the lane.
short: Grant round 4 for the ruled-store change
title: Grant a fourth review round for the ruled-store change (PR #2992)?
why: A round past the three-round cap needs your grant.
